detail: Full summary: Plugin 1.17.0 (no --project arg) is safe against 2.1.0 servers — cwd default is identical — but TWINING_PROJECT itself needs a server >= 2.2 release to take effect. The env-var feature is inert for users until the next server tag is pushed.
